chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: feature source time <= generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= persist acknowledgement < original candidate cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.design: One fixed real-time Grade-R engineering card after synthetic-only preparation and a distinct run approval; there is no fitting, fold selection, backtest, ROI, or model comparison.
chronological_fold_design.domain_rule: Obstacle and unknown races remain in the denominator but cannot become candidate-ready.
chronological_fold_design.history_clock: Only prior-race history through 2026-08-07 that was available before the target cutoff may enter runner features.
chronological_fold_design.input_clock: HTM, DU, and DR hashes and observed modification times are fixed before candidate construction; DR data category must be the pre-race entry category and its post time must match the pre-registered schedule.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: A race whose original cutoff has passed before persistence is retained as deterministic no-bet and is never backfilled.
chronological_fold_design.quote_clock: Frozen candidate first; then exact-pair polling; quote source, receipt, and selected-asof times must all be at or before strict T-3.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real 2026-08-08 inference, quote, outcome, payout, or ROI operation is allowed during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.
chronological_fold_design.schedule_clock: A uniquely identified schedule version received before decision is locked before quote access; no actual post time is used retrospectively.
